structured_output.summary: In src/input/gamepad.ts connectedPads(), the navigator.getGamepads() call is now wrapped in try/catch. On a throw it returns [], exactly like the existing guard for a missing API. The throw is the SecurityError the browser raises when the gamepad permissions policy blocks the API, for example in a cross-origin iframe without allow="gamepad". readGamepads() and the confirm-edge poll both go through connectedPads(), so input.read() and input.confirmPressed() no longer throw. Keyboard and touch keep working, and frame() keeps ticking. When getGamepads works, nothing changes. Added the verifier's test as tests/input/gamepad-blocked.test.ts. It failed before the fix and passes after it. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes (82 files, 623 tests).
